metadata.title: When you land 2 kills but still feel like the accidental duo MVP in VALORANT
metadata.description:
I swear I didn’t plan this double trouble.
My aim was just guessing but hey, it worked!
VALORANT logic: accidental clutch is still clutch.

Click if your luck outplays your skill too!
